label: ROOF
description: Open sky, a rusted rail and the only place on the outpost where nobody listens.

label: QUARTERS
description: Bunk rooms and the commander's cell. A soldier sent here has nowhere else to go.

label: COMMS
description: A humming rack of corporate radios and one chair that always seems to be taken.

label: MESS HALL
description: Long tables, a dented serving line and whatever the stew is today.

label: MEDBAY
description: Where the injured lie up and defects are worked on. A soldier on the cot is not going anywhere.

label: WORKSHOP
description: Benches, a PLYX press and the smell of hot solder. Duty shifts end up here.

label: GARAGE
description: Two stripped transports and a floor nobody has ever managed to get clean.

label: TRAINING YARD
description: Packed dirt, scarred targets and a rack of weapons that have all been fired in anger.
